In a separate message, the foreign minister, Seyyed Abbas Araghchi, expressed sorrow over Abdi’s death, noting that his enduring performances earned him a distinguished and lasting place in the history of Iranian cinema and in the collective memory of the Iranian people.
​
The Minister of Culture and Islamic Guidance, Seyyed Abbas Salehi, likewise wrote that the passing of this famous artist has brought grief and sadness to all who care for Iran.
​
Akbar Abdi, a well‑known actor of Iranian cinema, theatre, and television, born on August 26, 1960, passed away late on Friday, July 23, 2026, due to cardiac arrest at the age of 66.
